rationale: Add a custom job timeout (10 minutes) to the CodeQL analysis job. Historical CI runs show the job completes in ~50-60 seconds; a 10-minute timeout provides ample headroom while preventing runaway consumption if the CodeQL action hangs. This optimization is supported by pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (literature reports 12.9% free / 8.1% paid VM time reduction) and an experiment example showing 26.8% elapsed time savings when a 5-minute timeout was added to a similar job. The workflow has no matrix, no dependency installation (uses build-mode: none), and already uses concurrency cancellation, so other patterns (caching, fail-fast, stale cancellation) are not applicable or already present. Scheduled-run suppression patterns are contraindicated because CodeQL security scanning should run periodically regardless of repository activity.
